```{julia}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| output: false

using DICOM
using DataFrames
using Plots
using CSV
using Glob
using Statistics
using Printf

# --- FIX: Force GR backend to output PNGs for Quarto/IJulia ---
gr(fmt=:png)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

# --- CONFIGURATION ---
folder = "scanner_name/"
sr = "series_name" 
DICOM_DIR = joinpath(folder, sr)
mkpath(sr)

MEAS_ACT_SPH = 27.40e3       # kBq/mL
MEAS_ACT_BCK = 28.04e6/9575  # kBq/ml
SCAN_TIME_DIFF = 44          # min
HALF_LIFE = 109.7            # min (F-18)

TRUE_ACT_SPH = MEAS_ACT_SPH * 0.5^(SCAN_TIME_DIFF / HALF_LIFE)
TRUE_ACT_BCK = MEAS_ACT_BCK * 0.5^(SCAN_TIME_DIFF / HALF_LIFE)
DIAMETERS = [10.0, 13.0, 17.0, 22.0, 28.0, 37.0]

MANUAL_OFFSETS_MAP = Dict(
    10.0 => (1.0, 0.0, 1.0),
    13.0 => (1.0, 0.0, 1.0),
    17.0 => (-1.0, 0.0, 2.0),
    22.0 => (0.0, 0.0, -3.0),
    28.0 => (0.0, 0.0, 4.0),
    37.0 => (3.0, 3.0, 4.0)
)
```

# Series: `{julia} sr` 
This report documents the quality control analysis for the dataset using the NEMA/EARL phantom. The analysis includes geometric verification, Maximum Intensity Projections (MIPs) for alignment checks, intensity profile analysis, and quantitative recovery coefficient (RC) calculations.

```{julia}
#| label: load-and-process
#| echo: false
#| output: false

function load_dicom_volume(directory)
    file_list = glob("*.dcm", directory)
    if isempty(file_list)
        file_list = filter(f -> isfile(f), readdir(directory, join=true))
    end
    
    dcm_data = [dcm_parse(f) for f in file_list]
    
    # Sort by ImagePositionPatient Z coordinate
    sort!(dcm_data, by = d -> Float64(d[(0x0020, 0x0032)][3]))
    
    dcm_first = dcm_data[1]
    ps = dcm_first[(0x0028, 0x0030)] # PixelSpacing
    
    if length(dcm_data) > 1
        dz = abs(Float64(dcm_data[2][(0x0020, 0x0032)][3]) - Float64(dcm_data[1][(0x0020, 0x0032)][3]))
    else
        dz = Float64(dcm_first[(0x0028, 0x0030)][1]) # Fallback
    end
    
    voxel_size = (Float64(ps[1]), Float64(ps[2]), dz)
    rows = Int(dcm_first[(0x0028, 0x0010)])
    cols = Int(dcm_first[(0x0028, 0x0011)])
    
    img = zeros(Float64, rows, cols, length(dcm_data))
    for (i, d) in enumerate(dcm_data)
        slope = Float64(get(d, (0x0028, 0x1053), 1.0))
        intercept = Float64(get(d, (0x0028, 0x1052), 0.0))
        raw_pixels = Float64.(d[tag"PixelData"])
        img[:, :, i] = permutedims((raw_pixels .* slope) .+ intercept)
    end
    
    return img, voxel_size
end

function create_sphere_mask(img_shape, center, radius_mm, voxel_size)
    mask = zeros(Bool, img_shape...)
    c_px = center ./ voxel_size
    r_px = radius_mm ./ voxel_size
    
    x_min = max(1, floor(Int, c_px[1] - r_px[1]))
    x_max = min(img_shape[1], ceil(Int, c_px[1] + r_px[1] + 2))
    y_min = max(1, floor(Int, c_px[2] - r_px[2]))
    y_max = min(img_shape[2], ceil(Int, c_px[2] + r_px[2] + 2))
    z_min = max(1, floor(Int, c_px[3] - r_px[3]))
    z_max = min(img_shape[3], ceil(Int, c_px[3] + r_px[3] + 2))
    
    for z in z_min:z_max
        dz2 = ((z - 0.5) * voxel_size[3] - center[3])^2
        dz2 > radius_mm^2 && continue
        for y in y_min:y_max
            dy2 = ((y - 0.5) * voxel_size[2] - center[2])^2
            dy2 + dz2 > radius_mm^2 && continue
            for x in x_min:x_max
                dx2 = ((x - 0.5) * voxel_size[1] - center[1])^2
                if dx2 + dy2 + dz2 <= radius_mm^2
                    mask[x, y, z] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return mask
end

function center_of_mass(crop)
    tot = sum(crop)
    tot == 0 && return size(crop) ./ 2.0
    cx = sum(x * crop[x, y, z] for x in 1:size(crop, 1), y in 1:size(crop, 2), z in 1:size(crop, 3)) / tot
    cy = sum(y * crop[x, y, z] for x in 1:size(crop, 1), y in 1:size(crop, 2), z in 1:size(crop, 3)) / tot
    cz = sum(z * crop[x, y, z] for x in 1:size(crop, 1), y in 1:size(crop, 2), z in 1:size(crop, 3)) / tot
    return (cx, cy, cz)
end

function auto_find_centers(image, voxel_size)
    temp = copy(image)
    temp[temp .< 0.1 * maximum(temp)] .= 0.0
    
    centers = Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64}[]
    r_px = [round(Int, 20.0 / v) for v in voxel_size]
    
    for _ in 1:6
        idx = argmax(temp)
        idx_tup = Tuple(idx)
        
        sl_x = max(1, idx_tup[1] - r_px[1]):min(size(temp, 1), idx_tup[1] + r_px[1])
        sl_y = max(1, idx_tup[2] - r_px[2]):min(size(temp, 2), idx_tup[2] + r_px[2])
        sl_z = max(1, idx_tup[3] - r_px[3]):min(size(temp, 3), idx_tup[3] + r_px[3])
        
        crop = temp[sl_x, sl_y, sl_z]
        if sum(crop) > 0
            local_com = center_of_mass(crop)
            global_com = (sl_x.start + local_com[1] - 1, sl_y.start + local_com[2] - 1, sl_z.start + local_com[3] - 1)
        else
            global_com = Float64.(idx_tup)
        end
        
        c_mm = (global_com .- 0.5) .* voxel_size
        push!(centers, c_mm)
        
        mask = create_sphere_mask(size(image), c_mm, 30.0, voxel_size)
        temp[mask] .= 0.0
    end
    
    sort!(centers, by = c -> sum(image[create_sphere_mask(size(image), c, 30.0, voxel_size)]))
    
    lx = mean([c[1] for c in centers])
    ly = mean([c[2] for c in centers])
    lz = mean([c[3] for c in centers])
    return centers, (lx, ly, lz)
end

function check_and_fix_orientation(image, voxel_size, centers, lung_center)
    coords = hcat([collect(c) for c in centers]...)'
    stds = [std(coords[:, i]) for i in 1:3]
    z_axis_idx = argmin(stds)
    
    if z_axis_idx == 2
        image = permutedims(image, (1, 3, 2))
        voxel_size = (voxel_size[1], voxel_size[3], voxel_size[2])
        centers = [(c[1], c[3], c[2]) for c in centers]
        lung_center = (lung_center[1], lung_center[3], lung_center[2])
    elseif z_axis_idx == 1
        image = permutedims(image, (3, 2, 1))
        voxel_size = (voxel_size[3], voxel_size[2], voxel_size[1])
        centers = [(c[3], c[2], c[1]) for c in centers]
        lung_center = (lung_center[3], lung_center[2], lung_center[1])
    end
    
    return image, voxel_size, centers, lung_center
end

# Run Loading & Processing
img, v_size = load_dicom_volume(DICOM_DIR)
centers_raw, lung_loc = auto_find_centers(img, v_size)
img, v_size, centers_raw, lung_loc = check_and_fix_orientation(img, v_size, centers_raw, lung_loc)

centers = Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64}[]
for (i, c) in enumerate(centers_raw)
    off = get(MANUAL_OFFSETS_MAP, DIAMETERS[i], (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    push!(centers, (c[1] + off[1], c[2] + off[2], c[3] + off[3]))
end
```

# Geometric Verification & MIPs

The following figures verify the geometric detection of spheres and their alignment in the scanner field of view. Original spheres are shown in solid red, and the 37 mm background VOIs (shifted -55 mm in Z) are shown in dashed blue in the Coronal view.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-1
#| fig-cap: "Axial (XY) and Coronal (XZ) Maximum Intensity Projections."
#| echo: false
#| out-width: "65%"

function plot_fig1_mips(image, voxel_size, centers, diameters, lung_center)
    mip_z = maximum(image, dims=3)[:, :, 1]'
    mip_y = maximum(image, dims=2)[:, 1, :]'
    
    x_ax = (1:size(image, 1)) .* voxel_size[1]
    y_ax = (1:size(image, 2)) .* voxel_size[2]
    z_ax = (1:size(image, 3)) .* voxel_size[3]
    
    p1 = heatmap(x_ax, y_ax, mip_z, color=cgrad(:greys, rev=true), legend=false, title="Axial (XY)", aspect_ratio=:equal, xlabel="X (mm)", ylabel="Y (mm)", xlims=(0, 600), ylims=(0, 600))
    p2 = heatmap(x_ax, z_ax, mip_y, color=cgrad(:greys, rev=true), legend=false, title="Coronal (XZ)", aspect_ratio=:equal, xlabel="X (mm)", ylabel="Z (mm)", xlims=(0, 600), ylims=(-100, 500))
    
    θ = range(0, 2π, length=100)
    for (i, c) in enumerate(centers)
        # Original Spheres
        r = diameters[i] / 2.0
        plot!(p1, c[1] .+ r .* cos.(θ), c[2] .+ r .* sin.(θ), color=:red, lw=0.5)
        plot!(p2, c[1] .+ r .* cos.(θ), c[3] .+ r .* sin.(θ), color=:red, lw=0.5)
        
        # New Background VOIs (37mm diameter, shifted -55mm in Z) 
        # Displayed only on Coronal (XZ) plot
        r_bg = 37.0 / 2.0
        c_bg = (c[1], c[2], c[3] - 55.0)
        plot!(p2, c_bg[1] .+ r_bg .* cos.(θ), c_bg[3] .+ r_bg .* sin.(θ), color=:blue, lw=0.5, linestyle=:dash)
    end
    
    p = plot(p1, p2, layout=(1, 2), size=(1536, 768), bottom_margin=8Plots.mm, left_margin=8Plots.mm)
    savefig(p, joinpath(sr, "fig1_$(sr).png"))
    return p
end

plot_fig1_mips(img, v_size, centers, DIAMETERS, lung_loc)
```

## Sphere Intensity Profiles

Cross-sectional profiles through the center of selected spheres are shown below. The dashed line indicates the expected true activity concentration.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-2
#| fig-cap: "Intensity Profiles for Spheres (Relative RC). The x-axis represents the distance from the sphere center in millimeters (mm)."
#| echo: false

function plot_fig2_profiles(image, voxel_size, centers, diameters, true_act)
    targets = [10.0, 13.0, 17.0, 22.0, 28.0, 37.0]
    win_mm = 40.0
    win_px = [round(Int, win_mm / v) for v in voxel_size]
    
    plots_list = []
    
    for (i, t) in enumerate(targets)
        idx = argmin(abs.(diameters .- t))
        c = centers[idx]
        r = t / 2.0
        
        ci = [round(Int, x / v) for (x, v) in zip(c, voxel_size)]
        
        h_prof = image[:, ci[2], ci[3]] ./ true_act
        v_prof = image[ci[1], :, ci[3]] ./ true_act
        
        sx, ex = max(1, ci[1] - win_px[1]), min(length(h_prof), ci[1] + win_px[1])
        sy, ey = max(1, ci[2] - win_px[2]), min(length(v_prof), ci[2] + win_px[2])
        
        xa_h = ((sx:ex) .- ci[1]) .* voxel_size[1]
        xa_v = ((sy:ey) .- ci[2]) .* voxel_size[2]
        
        p = plot(xa_h, h_prof[sx:ex], color=:blue, label="Horiz", title="$(Int(t))mm Sphere", ylims=(0, 1.5))
        plot!(p, xa_v, v_prof[sy:ey], color=:green, label="Vert")
        
        vline!(p, [-r, r], color=:red, linestyle=:dash, label="")
        hline!(p, [1.0], color=:blue, linestyle=:dash, label="")
        
        push!(plots_list, p)
    end
    
    p_all = plot(plots_list..., layout=(2, 3), size=(1200, 800), legend=false)
    savefig(p_all, joinpath(sr, "fig2_$(sr).png"))
    return p_all
end

plot_fig2_profiles(img, v_size, centers, DIAMETERS, TRUE_ACT_SPH)
```

# Recovery Coefficients

The table below lists the calculated Recovery Coefficients (RC) for all spheres. Background VOI (37 mm diameter, shifted -55 mm in Z) metrics are included.

\footnotesize

```{julia}
#| label: calc-stats
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

function get_stats(image, voxel_size, centers, diameters, true_act_sph, true_act_bck)
    valid_d, r_a50, r_max, r_peak, r_bg = Float64[], Float64[], Float64[], Float64[], Float64[]
    sr_pixel = max(1, round(Int, 4.0 / voxel_size[1]))
    results = []
    
    all_vals_bg = Float64[]
    
    for (i, d) in enumerate(diameters)
        c = centers[i]
        
        # Original Sphere Processing
        m_phy = create_sphere_mask(size(image), c, d / 2.0, voxel_size)
        vals = image[m_phy]
        isempty(vals) && continue
        
        act_max = maximum(vals)
        act_mean = mean(vals)
        vals_a50 = vals[vals .>= 0.5 * act_max]
        act_a50 = isempty(vals_a50) ? 0.0 : mean(vals_a50)
        
        ci = [round(Int, x / v) for (x, v) in zip(c, voxel_size)]
        best_peak = 0.0
        for dz in -1:1, dy in -sr_pixel:sr_pixel, dx in -sr_pixel:sr_pixel
            cm = ((ci[1] + dx - 0.5) * voxel_size[1], (ci[2] + dy - 0.5) * voxel_size[2], (ci[3] + dz - 0.5) * voxel_size[3])
            m_p = create_sphere_mask(size(image), cm, 6.0, voxel_size)
            curr = any(m_p) ? mean(image[m_p]) : 0.0
            if curr > best_peak best_peak = curr end
        end
        
        # Background VOI Processing (37mm diameter, shifted -55mm in Z)
        c_bg = (c[1], c[2], c[3] - 55.0)
        m_bg = create_sphere_mask(size(image), c_bg, 37.0 / 2.0, voxel_size)
        vals_bg = image[m_bg]
        append!(all_vals_bg, vals_bg) # Accumulate for total stats calculation
        
        act_bg = isempty(vals_bg) ? 0.0 : mean(vals_bg)
        std_bg = isempty(vals_bg) ? 0.0 : std(vals_bg)
        
        push!(valid_d, d)
        push!(r_a50, act_a50 / true_act_sph)
        push!(r_max, act_max / true_act_sph)
        push!(r_peak, best_peak / true_act_sph)
        push!(r_bg, act_bg / true_act_bck)
        
        push!(results, (d, act_mean / true_act_sph, act_a50 / true_act_sph, act_max / true_act_sph, best_peak / true_act_sph, act_bg / true_act_bck, act_bg, std_bg))
    end
    
    # Calculate pooled Background Total metrics
    total_mean_bg = isempty(all_vals_bg) ? 0.0 : mean(all_vals_bg)
    total_std_bg  = isempty(all_vals_bg) ? 0.0 : std(all_vals_bg)
    total_snr_bg  = total_std_bg != 0 ? total_mean_bg / total_std_bg : 0.0
    total_rc_bg   = total_mean_bg / true_act_bck
    
    total_bg_stats = (total_mean_bg, total_std_bg, total_snr_bg, total_rc_bg)
    
    return valid_d, r_a50, r_max, r_peak, r_bg, results, total_bg_stats
end

d_list, ra, rm, rp, rbg, stats_data, bg_totals = get_stats(img, v_size, centers, DIAMETERS, TRUE_ACT_SPH, TRUE_ACT_BCK)

df = DataFrame(
    "Diameter (mm)" => [x[1] for x in stats_data],
    "RC Phy" => [round(x[2], digits=2) for x in stats_data],
    "RC Mean" => [round(x[3], digits=2) for x in stats_data],
    "RC Max" => [round(x[4], digits=2) for x in stats_data],
    "RC Peak" => [round(x[5], digits=2) for x in stats_data],
    "RC BG" => [round(x[6], digits=2) for x in stats_data]
)

CSV.write(joinpath(sr, "RecCoef-$(sr).csv"), df)

println("\n")
println("Diameter (mm)   RC Phy          RC Mean         RC Max          RC Peak         RC BG")
println("-------------   -------------   -------------   -------------   -------------   -------------")
for r in eachrow(df)
    @printf("%-13.1f   %-13.2f   %-13.2f   %-13.2f   %-13.2f   %-13.2f\n", r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6])
end
println("\n")
```

# Recovery Curves

```{julia}
#| label: fig-3
#| fig-cap: "Recovery Coefficient curves"
#| echo: false
#| out-width: "90%"

function plot_fig3_curves(diameters, rc_a50, rc_max, rc_peak)
    vols = [(4/3) * π * ((d / 2) / 10)^3 for d in diameters]
    
    p1 = plot(vols, rc_a50, m=:circle, color=:blue, title="RC Mean", ylims=(0.2, 1.4))
    hline!(p1, [1.0], linestyle=:dot, color=:grey)
    
    p2 = plot(vols, rc_max, m=:circle, color=:red, title="RC Max", ylims=(0.2, 1.4))
    hline!(p2, [1.0], linestyle=:dot, color=:grey)
    
    p3 = plot(vols, rc_peak, m=:circle, color=:green, title="RC Peak", xlabel="Volume (mL)", ylims=(0.2, 1.4))
    hline!(p3, [1.0], linestyle=:dot, color=:grey)
    
    p = plot(p1, p2, p3, layout=(3, 1), size=(800, 700), legend=false)
    savefig(p, joinpath(sr, "fig3_$(sr).png"))
    return p
end

plot_fig3_curves(d_list, ra, rm, rp)
```
